description: TensorFeed's signed dependability ruling over its OWN measured latency and availability probes of the frontier AI providers: the single most-dependable provider to build on and the riskiest, scoring availability and tail consistency (p50 over p95) equally because an agent retry loop feels the tail, not the median. tier='preview' is free (10 calls per day per IP), top verdict only. tier='full' costs 1 credit ($0.02) and adds the full per-provider ranking with measured availability and p50/p95/p99 and tail spread plus an AFTA-signed receipt. Omit tier and you get the free preview, unless the call carries a payment or credits token (or uses the strict x402 transport), in which case it bills as full. Pay per call with an x402 wallet payment (arguments.payment, or an X-PAYMENT header; strict HTTP-402 transport at https://mcp.tensorfeed.ai/mcp?x402=strict) or use an Authorization: Bearer tf_live_... credits token. No token and no USDC? Claim free trial credits by signing a wallet message at https://tensorfeed.ai/api/payment/trial-credits.

payment.description: Optional base64 x402 payment payload (the same string an X-PAYMENT header would carry). Sign against the accepts[0] requirement returned by an unpaid call. Alternative to the Bearer credits token.

tier.description: 'preview' (free, 10 calls per IP per day) or 'full' (1 credit; adds the full per-provider ranking and signed receipt). Omitted: preview, unless a payment or credits token is attached.

name: provider_reliability_verdict
